question: Three of the following letter-clusters are alike in some manner and hence form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• First and third letters → Opposite letters according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Second and third letters → Difference between the position values according to English alphabetic series is (3).

​So,

 
• UCF

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5050bd5a9465aca77242298144556912e317b970ea711b647778736629e08c98.png] 

 
• ZXA

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1cce14f5ab4d969f5df0121c4b15c0f3879baa89f816350d2c672c27499b25a.png] 

 
• NJM

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac42e43326bdb5536620948bf05bb2e71d0bbf366d5562c349b35dc60d8d8fd7.png] 

 
• HDX

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c67bf8b5f9a82c641c25590fbcf9b8509909c96494a2aa4cdec544b2627b82f.png] 

Thus, out of all options **only 'HDX' doesn't follows the same logic as others.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"HDX**".
